prompt:
Create one clean pixel-art working atlas for NPC 083, guarded emotion, using the supplied reference grid as the exact visual source. Preserve the exact face identity, palette, skin shading, dark eye shadow, both source lid contours and compact aperture shapes, iris/pupil size and actual muted gray-violet color, eyebrow shape and expression, and all exterior pixels. Do not widen or open the eyes, show more sclera, change the eye makeup/shadow, or alter the guarded brows.

Canvas: exact 64:35 aspect ratio; 2 columns × 2 rows, no gutters or labels. Top row: LEFT gaze open, RIGHT gaze open. Bottom row: LEFT gaze half-lidded, RIGHT gaze half-lidded. Repeat each eye phase consistently for both eyes. The only open-phase change from the reference is a very gentle lateral glance of about one native pixel: pupils/irises move left in the left cells and right in the right cells, remaining inside the existing narrow apertures. Keep iris contour, size and color unchanged. Retain muted warm beige sclera and only tiny mild glints; no bright white bands or broad exposed sclera. Half-lid phases must preserve the source's heavy lid shape and lower it naturally without adding eye geometry.

Keep the image crisp, low-resolution pixel art with stepped native contours, no smoothing, no painterly detail, no text, no extra panels, and no face redesign.
